passage.traditional: 今天是媽媽的生日，我和爸爸送她一些禮物。我送她兩{1}中文書，爸爸送她一{2}漂亮的衣服和一些花。紅色的花、白色的花，媽媽{3}很喜歡。晚上我們一起吃蛋糕，媽媽很{4}。
passage.simplified: 今天是妈妈的生日，我和爸爸送她一些礼物。我送她两{1}中文书，爸爸送她一{2}漂亮的衣服和一些花。红色的花、白色的花，妈妈{3}很喜欢。晚上我们一起吃蛋糕，妈妈很{4}。
passage.pinyin: Jīntiān shì māma de shēngrì, wǒ hé bàba sòng tā yìxiē lǐwù. Wǒ sòng tā liǎng běn Zhōngwén shū, bàba sòng tā yí jiàn piàoliàng de yīfu hé yìxiē huā. Hóngsè de huā, báisè de huā, māma dōu hěn xǐhuān. Wǎnshàng wǒmen yìqǐ chī dàngāo, māma hěn kāixīn.
passage.english: Today is Mom's birthday, and Dad and I give her some gifts. I give her two Chinese books, and Dad gives her a pretty top and some flowers. Red flowers, white flowers: Mom likes them all. In the evening we eat cake together, and Mom is very happy.

questions.why: Books take 本: 兩本中文書. 枝 is for pens.
件 is the measure word for clothes: 一件漂亮的衣服. 枝 is for pens.
都 sums up the red and the white flowers: she likes them all.
很 needs a describing word after it: 很開心, very happy.

passage.traditional: 我和媽媽去買筆。這{1}筆很可愛，有紅色的和白色的，媽媽和我{2}喜歡白色的。紅色的一枝四十塊，白色的一枝二十塊，白色的很{3}。我們買兩枝白色{4}筆。
passage.simplified: 我和妈妈去买笔。这{1}笔很可爱，有红色的和白色的，妈妈和我{2}喜欢白色的。红色的一枝四十块，白色的一枝二十块，白色的很{3}。我们买两枝白色{4}笔。
passage.pinyin: Wǒ hé māma qù mǎi bǐ. Zhè zhǒng bǐ hěn kě'ài, yǒu hóngsè de hé báisè de, māma hé wǒ dōu xǐhuān báisè de. Hóngsè de yì zhī sìshí kuài, báisè de yì zhī èrshí kuài, báisè de hěn piányí. Wǒmen mǎi liǎng zhī báisè de bǐ.
passage.english: Mom and I go to buy pens. This kind of pen is cute. It comes in red and white, and Mom and I both like the white ones. The red ones are forty each and the white ones twenty each, so the white ones are cheap. We buy two white pens.

bank.english: (links a description to a noun, or stands for it)

questions.why: 種 means kind: 這種筆, this kind of pen. Pens never take 本.
都 comes after the group (媽媽和我) and before the verb: we both like white.
20 is less than 40, so the white ones are 很便宜, cheap.
的 links the color to the noun: 白色的筆, white pens.
